changes: The four reusable parcel crates now collide with one another using their measured .335 X/.295 Z/.325 Y half extents. A deterministic bounded pair solver separates floor piles, stacks falling crates, transfers equal-mass momentum with low restitution, adds bounded travel-to-roll response on vertical impact and treats carried host/guest crates as fixed anchors without moving either player. Horizontal correction consults the existing prop-specific world blocker and moves the clear partner fully when the other side is obstructed. The host splits fast frames into at most eight movement/pair-contact substeps so thrown crates do not pass through one another; guests remain read-only. Existing optional angular fields and version-3 save format preserve resolved positions/velocities without migration. Player, worker, vehicle and placement collision, crate count, business inventory/economy, expanded town and original assets/resources remain unchanged; browser imports advance to v56.

Thrown parcel crates now receive deterministic bounded three-axis angular impulse, tumble during existing swept flight, damp/reverse spin on wall contact and settle tilt/spin to a stable upright rest on support. Carried crates stabilise and Shift+G remains a zero-linear/zero-angular set-down. Optional finite rotation/spin fields preserve in-flight version-3 saves while old/invalid saves derive safe values. Host authority, replay and guest read-only presentation are preserved. A measured-axis presentation lift prevents rotated corners clipping below support without changing conservative axis-aligned collision, player/worker/vehicle/placement routes, inventory/economy or original assets; browser imports advance to v55.

Parcel-crate gravity and swept movement now query finite existing town pavement and pier supports at their authored mesh tops (.105/.085/.09), padded by the measured crate footprint and combined with existing RV/tent support. Host simulation settles stationary, moving and legacy low crates on these surfaces without x/z drift or persisted schema changes. Player/worker/vehicle/placement physics and original assets remain unchanged.

Empty parcel crates now require finite three-dimensional reach and a clear wall-free path before pickup. Held and thrown movement uses small swept steps with axis sliding/bounce; lost holder contact releases at the last safe position instead of teleporting. Shift+G and a menu button set a crate down without a throw impulse. Ground settling and bounded steps/velocities prevent runaway motion. Host-owned simulation, co-op ownership/replay rules, crate count, save v3 and business inventory are preserved; no model/rig changes.

Legacy low crates settle to center y=1.24 on the corrected RV floor; held center follows y=2.12. Actual grab/drop/settle/reload checks preserve business stock and mesh count. Shared host authority and guest save/simulation protection remain intact.

Seven fixed gameplay collision records make existing floor furnishings physically solid without adding rendered resources. Shared authoritative approach tests reject shelf-embedded transfers, preserve valid/replayed transfers, and keep guest-local recovery separate from host business and personal saves.

Bounded rotated component collision replaces walk-through installed canvas without adding scene resources or rewriting saved equipment/crops. Recovery ignores only enclosing bodies along the path, refuses other blocked geometry, and never runs on the host's temporary authoritative remote-command pose.

Installed tents now derive .08 floor support and conservative 2.255 roof / 2.0525 lamp headroom from the unchanged original export, rotated with canonical default/saved poses at all three homes.
